notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
Hello, Warriors!

We’re excited to announce a major update that has just arrived, bringing new features and several improvements to our game. Check out the highlights below!

New Additions:

 New Game Mode: Quick Match – Face off against your opponent in a thrilling battle where the goal is to destroy three of their towers first. Speed and strategy are key to victory!
 New Training Mode – You can now hone your skills by battling against bots, developing better strategies, and preparing for real combat.
 Elemental Cards – New elemental cards have been introduced! Some cards now have usage restrictions based on specific elements. Example: the "X" card can only be equipped by heroes of the "X" element.
 Revamped Ranking System – Compete for glory and prove your worth among the top players.


Balancing Adjustments:

 Card Rebalancing – Several cards have had their stats adjusted for better gameplay balance and competition.
 Hero Adjustments – Some heroes have also received stat changes to improve game balance.


Bug Fixes:

 We’ve fixed issues affecting the user interface (UI).
 Resolved bugs related to matchmaking.
 Improved synchronization during matches for a smoother experience.


We’re always focused on improving the game and strengthening our community. Don’t forget that our Discord server is open to all players! There, you can easily find others to play with and provide feedback directly to our team. Your input is crucial to the growth of BoZ!

Thank you all for your continued support. Together, let’s make BoZ an even greater game!

notes.title: Update 03/18/2024
notes.content:
Added:


 New hero: General Satyrus of Serpentarius
 Element Restrictions: Some cards now have element restrictions for use. Exp.: Card “X” can only be equipped by heroes of the element “X”.
Shortcuts for using hero actions:
 Q = Floor
 W = Attack
 E = Use Astral Skill


Adjustments:

 Minor bug fixes


Big New: ASTRAL TOURNAMENT

During the months of April, May and June we will have the monthly tournament, where at the end of each month the TOP 10 players will be awarded BIGM Tokens.

BIGM is a token that will be used in future games from The Big Marck, Play to Win (P2E) models on web3. Find out more on the website: www.battleofzodiacs.com

Start: April 3rd – 12pm
END: April 28th - 11:59 pm

Prizes:
1st = 1000 BIGM
2nd= 800 BIGM
3rd = 500 BIGM
4 -5° = 250 BIGM
6° - 10 = 150 BIGM


We will contact players via Steam and after wallet selection, we will send tokens to the winners. After that, the ranking will be reset and a new tournament will be drawn.


We are working to improve our game and grow our gaming community.
Our discord server is open to all players, on this server you will be able to play with other players more easily and you will be able to pass on feedback to our team.

We thank everyone for their contribution. Let's make BoZ a great game together!

notes.title: Update 02/19/2024
notes.content:
Added:

 Training Mode: Players will now be able to test their strategies against a BOT, before facing players in ranked matches.


Settings:

 Minor bug fixes
 Removed the ability to see your opponent's land layout on the character choice screen. This way, players will only know which elements they will face when starting combat.




We are working to improve our game and grow our gaming community.
Our Discord server is open to all players, on this server you will be able to play with other players more easily and can pass feedback to our team.

We will have a new update for March called “Elementals”, where we will bring new cards and a serpent to the battlefield.

We thank everyone for their contribution. Let's make BoZ a great game together!

notes.title: Update 04/01/2024
notes.content:
Adjustments:

 Top 10 Players update error fixed
 Fixed error in the history of cards used by the player. Players can view the history of cards used by clicking on the discard pile on the board, next to the deck.


Heroes:

 Themis of Libra's Astral Ability is now global and can be used from anywhere on the map.


Added:

 “Surrender” button in the match. By clicking the configuration button during the match, the player will be able to surrender and give victory to the opponent.


We know how difficult it is for you to find matches in online mode and we are working to grow our community.
Our discord server is open to all players, on this server you will be able to play with other players more easily and can pass feedback to our team.

We thank everyone for their contribution. Let's make BoZ a great game together!

notes.title: BoZ - Time To Play! Let's grow the BoZ community together.
notes.content:
Hello BoZ players!

We are at the beginning of our journey and growing our community little by little.
As a result, you players are having difficulty finding online matches.
We reinforce that we are investing our resources in marketing to increase our player base.
In addition to challenging your friends on Steam, another way to find players is on our Discord server.
 Discord Link

Additionally, today Tuesday and Thursday at 8pm (Brazil) / 7pm (USA) we will have a player meeting event! Me or someone from The Big Marck team will be live (Steam/twitch.tv) playing with you. Of course, you will be able to play against other players.

Let's grow our community together and have fun on the battlefields in Zodiacus!
